essence: When intellect is overtaken by darkness, the person is excluded from rightful duty.
A king should especially know and undertake pacifying and nourishing rites.
The rite should be performed by an excellent person devoted to duty and qualified in the sāntānika context.
The installation of knowledge, in its power, will now be explained.
The knowledge-hall may be a spacious temple or a pavilion.
